cut_rule:
(provisional; byte identity does not depend on it): the first
object of a section starts at the section start; every later object starts at
its first evidence (anchored_start, the high end of its start window), so
unowned bytes between two objects go to the earlier object (the linker's
alignment-padding convention, same as the overlay agent).  An unaligned
anchored start is lowered to a 4-byte boundary inside the window.  A cut that
would split an original symbol moves to the symbol start.  config/imports.json
may override a TU's start in a section (or add a section the map missed).
